tools.name: inspect_metadata
tools.description: Read EXIF, XMP, IPTC, C2PA, and AI-generation markers from a JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Also reads a PDF info dictionary and XMP, or Word core and app properties. Pass a public file_url or file_base64.

tools.name: strip_metadata
tools.description: Return a cleaned JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, or DOCX as base64, plus the fields that were removed. Image mode ai_only keeps camera EXIF and GPS. Mode all removes them too. PDF and Word files drop document properties in either mode.
